failure_taxonomy.INFRA_AUTH_TRANSPORT_QUOTA: Runner/dependency/download/auth/transport/resource surface did not execute the discriminator. Repair execution surface, not product architecture.
failure_taxonomy.CONCURRENCY_RETRY: Claim/CAS race only; refresh and reuse winner.
